posts.title: Share the Prompt
posts.description: As humans, we like to share our original artifacts. When I take a great photograph, I might choose to run it through a compression algorithm to make it shareable, but I expect your software to then decompress it and help you see, more or less, the original. posts.title: Show Me You Care
posts.description: I am unimpressed by artifacts that, even a year ago, were impressive. Websites, apps, 3D renderings, interactive tech designs — anyone with a Claude subscription can churn these out like factory widgets. If you want my attention, show me you care. Show: I can tell how little you’ve invested when your writing sounds like an LLM or your artifacts look like everyone else’s. Me: My time and attention

posts.title: Working More Than Ever
posts.description: I am working more than ever. As a software engineer using AI, I can attempt more things than ever before, and I am. I’m seeing ambitious coworkers who are doing the same — maybe to an unsustainable degree. This may be surprising. Isn’t AI the ultimate automation tool and expected to eliminate jobs?
